A local thread snapshot at /private/tmp/eyes4s-compact-evidence-20261028/native-cohort-3af0f47a/admission-threads.txt identifies this path; admission did complete. Build counts once, then retain original trial-order first-error selection and existing declared/duplicate/shared/kinds error precedence. Use synthetic equivalence/error-order regressions and operation-count or scaling evidence, no relaxed validation. Separate from the unchanged-capacity qualification; no implementation change made in the frozen native pilot.
